message.content:
Let \(I = \int -\text{atan}(3x)\,dx\).

Use integration by parts with
\[
u = \text{atan}(3x), \quad dv = dx
\]
so
\[
du = \frac{3x}{1 + 9x^2}\,dx, \quad v = x
\]

Then
\[
\int \text{atan}(3x)\,dx = x\cdot\text{atan}(3x) - \int \frac{3x}{1 + 9x^2}\,dx
\]

Now,
\[
\int \frac{3x}{1 + 9x^2}\,dx = \frac{1}{6}\ln(1 + 9x^2)
\]

Therefore,
\[
\int -\text{atan}(3x)\,dx = -x\cdot\text{atan}(3x) + \frac{1}{6}\ln(1 + 9x^2) + C
\]

<answer>-x*atan(3*x) + (1/6)*ln(1 + 9*x**2) + C</answer>
